starter: Greet learners with a creative warm-up clap / body percussion.
Show samples of Ghanaian designs, logos and artworks; ask 'What do you see? Which ideas can you borrow from it?'

NEW TODAY (Week 1): In Creative Arts and Design we demonstrate understanding of design as a concept and its importance and role as a medium for creative expression of design in nature and the manmade environment.

plenary: Clean-up routine – tidy tools and materials.
Reflection: 'What inspired your design? What would you improve?'
Homework: collect natural/found materials or finish sketchbook ideas.
Preview next Design/Creative Arts lesson.
assessment: Class exercises; project work; SBA; BECE-style
